senses.sense_definition: iets of iemand naar een fysiek of geestelijk hoger niveau brengen

examples.text: De kunstenaar probeert met zijn werk de toeschouwer naar een hoger niveau te <w>verheffen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The artist tries to <w>elevate</w> the viewer to a higher level with his work.
target_lang_translations.it: L'artista cerca di <w>elevare</w> lo spettatore a un livello superiore con la sua opera.

examples.text: In de verte <w>verheffen</w> de bergen zich boven het vlakke landschap.

target_lang_translations.en: In the distance, the mountains <w>rise</w> above the flat landscape.
target_lang_translations.it: In lontananza le montagne si <w>ergono</w> sopra il paesaggio pianeggiante.

examples.text: Zij wilde haar stem <w>verheffen</w> om boven het lawaai van de menigte uit te komen.

target_lang_translations.en: She wanted to <w>raise</w> her voice to be heard above the noise of the crowd.
target_lang_translations.it: Voleva <w>alzare</w> la voce per farsi sentire sopra il rumore della folla.

target_lang_definitions.en: to bring something or someone to a physically or spiritually higher level
target_lang_definitions.it: portare qualcosa o qualcuno a un livello fisico o spirituale più alto

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to raise to a higher spiritual or intellectual level
to lift something physically or to increase volume
to improve the spiritual or emotional condition of someone
to move upwards or stand out above a landscape

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: portare a un livello spirituale, intellettuale o morale più alto
sollevare fisicamente o aumentare il volume della voce
innalzarsi o svettare rispetto al paesaggio

senses.sense_definition: iemand een hogere rang, titel of graad toekennen

examples.text: De koning besloot de trouwe dienaar in de adelstand te <w>verheffen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The king decided to <w>elevate</w> the loyal servant to the nobility.
target_lang_translations.it: Il re decise di <w>elevare</w> il fedele servitore al rango di nobile.

examples.text: Na jaren van studie werd hij eindelijk tot de meestergraad <w>verheven</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: After years of study, he was finally <w>raised</w> to the master's degree.
target_lang_translations.it: Dopo anni di studio fu finalmente <w>innalzato</w> al grado di maestro.

traits.comment: vaak gebruikt in formele of ceremoniële contexten

target_lang_definitions.en: to grant someone a higher rank, title, or degree
target_lang_definitions.it: conferire a qualcuno un rango, un titolo o un grado più elevato

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to promote someone to a higher rank or status
to advance someone to a higher position or office
to raise to a very high rank or character
to raise to the rank of nobility

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: promuovere qualcuno a un rango o status superiore
portare a una carica o posizione sociale più alta
